name: qr_code_generator
description: Generates QR code images from URLs or text strings and returns them as base64-encoded PNG data. Supports configurable size and error correction levels.

data.description: The text, URL, or data to encode into a QR code

size.description: Size of the QR code image in pixels (default 256)

error_correction.description: Error correction level: L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%), H (30%). Default M
